findingsWithCommentsSAST.title: Use_of_Insufficiently_Random_Values
userComments: [Confidence: HIGH 90%] Use_of_Insufficiently_Random_Values: Math.random() is used only to generate client-side DOM/component element IDs and UI correlation GUIDs (e.g., tabsetId, TrackGuidService.uuid), never for security tokens, session IDs, nonces, or cryptographic material. Weak randomness has no security impact in these contexts. Not exploitable.

findingsWithCommentsSAST.title: Log_Forging
userComments: [Confidence: MEDIUM 80%] Log_Forging: All flagged log calls use structured logging with named placeholders ({Identifier}, {Domain}, {Entity}) via ILogger, so user-influenced values are captured as discrete structured properties rather than concatenated into the log template; route/entity values are additionally validated against a registry. No practical log-forging vector. Not exploitable.
